description: Sets address attributes (IP/mask/etc.) of a device's interface. The result carries a `postcheck` (the serve re-reads the attributes after the write); a mismatch is 409 postcheck_failed (details.mismatches; details.rollback says whether the previous values were restored; details.restoreFailures lists every field that is NOT back at its previous value, re-read after the rollback): re-read with tia_device_network before retrying. Refused before anything is written, nothing changed: 409 node_attribute_list_unavailable (details.attributes, details.reason: the attribute list of the node could not be read, so it cannot be verified that the attributes can be written) and 409 node_attribute_unreadable (details.attributes: the current value could not be read, so a failed write could not be rolled back). Maps to POST /network/address. M-off.
